name: symphony
title: Orchestras and classical music presenters
description: For work with a symphony orchestra or classical presenter: what is written about the music they play (free-to-read first), the orchestras' own seasons and self-descriptions, and nonprofit filings for finances, staff and funders. First used for Berkeley Symphony (2026-09-29).

registries.use: Program and liner notes, essays, criticism, Bay Area arts press, artists' own sites and reference works. Free-to-read and mixed (per-article) sources by default.
Orchestras' own sites: seasons, programs, people, mission, press releases.
Form 990 filings and registration status: budgets, staff counts, officers, and (later) foundation grants.
Open-access musicology and arts-management research only, when a question needs it.

notes: Individual donors are out of scope by design: funders are organizations, and people appear only in public roles.
